title: F-Conjecture for the Nef Cone of Mbar_(0,n)
exact_target: Can nef divisors on every genus-zero pointed-curve moduli space be recognized by testing only the standard one-dimensional F-curves?

sources.citation: M. Fedorchuk and A. Mellit, Symmetric and non-symmetric F-conjectures are equivalent, arXiv 2507.12434.
